The total capital raised by the company since its establishment in 2022 stands at approximately $140 million. The latest round was led by venture capital funds and investors Ballistic Ventures, Greenfield Partners, Red Dot Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and TLV Partners, along with Yasmin Lukatz and Eyal Waldman.

Oligo Security was founded by CEO Nadav Czerninski, CTO Gal Elbaz, and CPO Avshalom Hilu, who are childhood friends and veterans of IDF cyber units in Military Intelligence (Units 81 and 8200) and the C4I Corps (Matzgov). The company currently reports employing about 100 workers, 70 of whom are at its development center in Israel, with the remainder at its offices in New York and San Francisco.

### **Funding growth fuels global expansion**
According to the company's announcement, the latest capital raise comes after increasing its annual recurring revenue (ARR) by more than 300% year-over-year, doubling its valuation since its Series B round, and expanding its operations. The additional capital is intended to accelerate product innovation and expand penetration into international markets.

Oligo provides runtime [security](https://www.jpost.com/tags/cyber-security) for applications, cloud environments, and artificial intelligence systems, combining runtime monitoring with real-time protection. The platform it developed identifies which vulnerabilities are exploitable by observing code behavior as it occurs, detects malicious activity in real time, and blocks attack attempts without disrupting the production environment.

excerpts:
# OLIGO Security Raises $60 Million, Bringing Total Funding To $140 Million

By Amit Chowdhry Aug 5, 2026

[Pulse 2.0](https://pulse2.com "Pulse 2.0")

OLIGO Security Raises $60 Million, Bringing Total Funding To $140 Million

[Follow Pulse 2.0 on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pulse2news)

OLIGO Security has raised $60 million in additional funding, bringing the runtime cybersecurity company’s total funding to $140 million. Participants included Ballistic Ventures, Canon Capital, Greenfield Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Red Dot Capital Partners and TLV Partners. The round also included angel investors such as Mellanox Technologies (acquired by NVIDIA for $6.9 billion) co-founder Eyal Waldman.

OLIGO plans to use the capital to accelerate product development, expand its global go-to-market operations and advance its technology for blocking zero-day and known vulnerability exploits in real time.
The company provides runtime security across applications, cloud workloads and AI systems.

Its platform monitors code while it is executing, helping customers identify vulnerabilities that can actually be exploited and block attacks without disrupting production environments.

OLIGO said the platform can reduce vulnerability alert noise and provide virtual patching capabilities between conventional software patch cycles.

The financing follows a period in which OLIGO reported 300% year-over-year revenue growth and more than doubled its valuation since its Series B round.

Amazon Web Services also selected OLIGO as the exclusive AI runtime security partner for AWS Security Hub Extended.

OLIGO joined Palantir’s FedStart Program to support its pursuit of FedRAMP High and Department of Defense Impact Level 5 authorization.

The company also launched Runtime Exploit Blocking, which detects and blocks application-layer exploitation attempts in real time.

# OLIGO Security Crosses $140M in Total Funding with $60M Round to Stop AI-Driven Attacks

Provided by Business Wire Aug 4, 2026, 8:00:00 PM

**OLIGO Security Crosses $140M in Total Funding with $60M Round to Stop AI-Driven Attacks**

_Round follows 300% year-over-year revenue growth driven by strong market demand for runtime security_

[OLIGO Security](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?
id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oligo.security%2F&esheet=54582494&newsitemid=20260804840699&lan=en-US&anchor=OLIGO+Security&index=1&md5=aa56119353b9dce9e80d1809266d0e66) , the runtime security company, today announced $60 million in additional funding, bringing the company’s total funding to $140 million. Participating investors include Ballistic Ventures, Canon Capital, Greenfield Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Red Dot Capital Partners, TLV Partners, and notable angel investors, such as Eyal Waldman, co-founder of Mellanox Technologies (acquired by NVIDIA for $6.9 billion).

“AI has fundamentally changed the economics of exploitation,” said Nadav Czerninski, co-founder and CEO of OLIGO Security. “When attackers can find vulnerabilities and build exploits at machine speed, runtime becomes the only place you can definitively understand true risk and stop attacks without impacting production.
Our investors have seen this transition firsthand through the outcomes we drive for customers, and they're doubling down because they know runtime will define the next era of cybersecurity.”

Today's announcement follows a year of exceptional momentum for OLIGO, highlighted by:

* 300% year-over-year revenue growth and more than doubling the company's valuation since its Series B.
* Selection by AWS as the exclusive AI runtime security partner for [AWS Security Hub Extended](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.businesswire.com%2Fnews%2Fhome%2F20260227188388%2Fen%2FOligo-Runtime-AI-Security-Integrates-with-New-Extended-Plan-for-AWS-Security-Hub&esheet=54582494&newsitemid=20260804840699&lan=en-US&anchor=AWS+Security+Hub+Extended&index=2&md5=34b0a6f3cef2b0139f35702966646107) .
* Joining [Palantir's FedStart Program](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.businesswire.
com%2Fnews%2Fhome%2F20260618553571%2Fen%2FOligo-Security-Joins-Palantirs-FedStart-Program-to-Accelerate-Runtime-Security-for-Federal-Agencies&esheet=54582494&newsitemid=20260804840699&lan=en-US&anchor=Palantir%27s+FedStart+Program&index=3&md5=6236d0e9b8ed48a4cecbe64b76843712) to accelerate its path to FedRAMP High and DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) authorization.
* The launch of [Runtime Exploit Blocking](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.businesswire.com%2Fnews%2Fhome%2F20260414822820%2Fen%2FOligo-Security-Brings-Real-Time-Exploit-Blocking-to-the-Application-Layer&esheet=54582494&newsitemid=20260804840699&lan=en-US&anchor=Runtime+Exploit+Blocking&index=4&md5=c5fdce2347497f38e2afb39850df908f) to extend runtime security to detect and block exploit attempts at the application layer in real time.

Together with growing enterprise adoption, these milestones reflect increasing market demand for runtime security as organizations adapt to AI-driven attacks.

Aqua Security

Aqua Security focuses on securing containerized cloud native applications within the cybersecurity sector. The company provides a lifecycle solution that includes pre-deployment hygiene enforcement and real-time attack mitigation for cloud native applications. Aqua's clientele consists of large enterprises that require cloud security. Aqua Security was formerly known as Scalock. It was founded in 2015 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.
